subject.title: Silent empty tool results in long-running Sonnet 5 sessions after a large tool result

question: Should https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99524 be treated as the canonical fix path for this Sonnet 5 large-result report before queueing a separate repair?
rationale: The candidate PR changes the same prompt-projection recovery path, but this report has a distinct Sonnet 5, large-result, no-marker trigger that has not been proven against current main or the PR head.

options.title: Review the candidate PR first
options.body: Evaluate and, if accepted, land the existing fresh-output projection fix, then retest this report's large-result Sonnet 5 scenario before opening another repair.

options.title: Keep a separate investigation
options.body: Treat this report as a distinct live/provider reproduction target and require additional payload traces before deciding whether the projection PR is sufficient.

options.title: Queue a new repair later
options.body: Only queue a new fix PR after maintainers establish that the candidate projection fix does not cover this report's failure path.

recommendation.title: Review the candidate PR first
recommendation.body: Evaluate and, if accepted, land the existing fresh-output projection fix, then retest this report's large-result Sonnet 5 scenario before opening another repair.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main blame and recent ownership signals route through the agent prompt assembly and provider transport paths he recently carried.
